name: svcapital-mobile
description: SV Capital Investor App — iOS & Android

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npm run apply:android && node scripts/check-android-config.js --warn && npx cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && npm run apply:ios && node scripts/check-ios-config.js --warn && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npm run apply:android && node scripts/check-android-config.js --warn && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npm run apply:ios && node scripts/check-ios-config.js --warn && npx cap run ios
scripts.release:android: npm run sync && npm run apply:android && node scripts/check-android-config.js && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
